title: Cystic fibrosis
summary: Cystic fibrosis makes mucus in the body thick and sticky. It mainly affects the lungs and digestion.
inheritance_plain: It is inherited in an autosomal recessive way: a child is affected only if they get a changed copy of the CFTR gene from both parents.
carrier_meaning: A carrier has one changed copy. Carriers are healthy and usually do not know they are carriers until they are tested.
disease_meaning: A person with two changed copies has cystic fibrosis. Treatment has improved greatly and is given by specialist teams.
screening: Carrier tests look for the most common changes; they cannot find every possible change.
suggested_questions: My sister has cystic fibrosis. Could I be a carrier?
Can cystic fibrosis skip a generation?
What does a test for the CFTR gene involve?
card_summary: Thick mucus affects the lungs and digestion. Carriers are healthy.
carrier_short: One changed copy. Healthy. Can pass the copy on.
disease_short: Two changed copies. Affects the lungs and digestion; needs specialist care.
care: Specialist respiratory clinics, genetic counselling and family support groups.
